aha_moments.user_pain: Multi-tenant SaaS customers worry about data isolation - one tenant accessing another's data is catastrophic
aha_moments.suggestion: Tenant spoofing prevention in JWT middleware validates X-Tenant-Id header matches JWT claim, blocking header manipulation attacks
aha_moments.aha_moment: When security audit confirms zero cross-tenant data leakage because header spoofing is blocked at middleware level

aha_moments.user_pain: PDF document processing takes too long when embedding hundreds of chunks one at a time with N+1 DB writes
aha_moments.suggestion: Multi-row UPDATE FROM VALUES batches 50 embeddings per single SQL statement, reducing DB round trips from N to N/50
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a 500-chunk PDF processes embeddings in seconds instead of minutes because batch SQL eliminates N+1 overhead

aha_moments.user_pain: Middleware bug fixes in one service never propagate to other services because each has its own copy-pasted middleware
aha_moments.suggestion: Consolidate 7 service-local middleware copies into single shared implementation that all services reference
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a security patch to JWT validation automatically protects all 7 services because there is only one source of truth

aha_moments.user_pain: Codex review cycles slow down feature delivery - each FAIL iteration adds hours of fix-review-fix loops
aha_moments.suggestion: Self-review protocol (CQ1-8 + AQ1-6) catches issues during coding, before Codex review even starts
aha_moments.aha_moment: When the first Codex review returns PASS at iteration 0 because self-review already caught all quality issues

aha_moments.user_pain: Services fail silently at startup with Console.Error output that operators never see in production log aggregators
aha_moments.suggestion: Replace Console.Error.WriteLine+Exit(1) with throw InvalidOperationException for proper error propagation to host/orchestrator
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a misconfigured service startup appears in alerting dashboards with actionable error details instead of silently dying
